# Torchx v0.12.0 - Table of Contents

LibTorch bindings and backend for Nx

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://torchx.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Torchx](https://torchx.hexdocs.pm/Torchx.md): Bindings and Nx integration for [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org/).
- [Torchx.Backend](https://torchx.hexdocs.pm/Torchx.Backend.md): An opaque backend Nx backend with bindings to libtorch/Pytorch.
